_meta.about: Small MemoryAgentBench (MAB)-shaped subset for the ADR-0006 advisory tier (issue #294, deferred from #37). NOT the official dataset: these are synthetic, license-clean, hand-authored entries that mirror the MAB subset schema for the two ADR-0006 subsets — Conflict Resolution (detect + overwrite outdated facts so only the newest valid value is returned) and Test-Time Learning (ingest a user-supplied rule/label during dialogue, then apply it). They exist so the advisory harness runs deterministically offline with zero deps and zero network in the default path. The official parquet subsets are pinned (url + sha256 + bytes) in download.mjs and fetched only by the gated --download lane; parquet decoding is deferred (no dependency added this batch).
_meta.metric: accuracy-over-turns: per question, the predicted answer (extracted from the answer-bearing turns of the best-ranked session) must contain the gold answer; the subset score is the fraction of questions answered correctly.
